jobs.title: Project Coordinator IV, Sustainability
jobs.description:
**The Work**

LACCD is spending bond money to cut energy use and carbon across its nine college campuses: solar, battery storage, microgrids, electric vehicle charging, new building controls, LED lighting, upgraded central plants, and swapping gas equipment for electric. The Sustainability Strike Team runs those projects. You are the person who keeps their money straight.

You work under the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, alongside the team's Cost Analyst and project managers. You help set up each new project with a budget, a funding check, and a cost estimate, then track it through design, construction, and closeout: forecasts, estimates to complete, change order requests, contract balances, invoices, and the monthly reconciliation. When the money looks like it will run short or a funding issue could hold up a contract, you see it first and say so.

This is a good seat for a cost analyst, project controls specialist, or project coordinator from a public capital program who is very strong in Excel and has worked in a project management system like Proliance or Trimble Unity. Energy or sustainability work helps, but it is not required.

**What You Will Do**

* Give day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the Strike Team Cost Analyst, the project managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team
* Help set up new projects and write their white papers: financial documents, funding checks, early budgets, cost estimates, and reviews, following the program office's standard procedures
* Check project budgets, available funding, estimates, and forecasts with District staff, college project teams, the program office, and program controls
* Build and keep cost forecasts and estimates to complete, and track change order requests, commitments, and available funding
* Watch budgets, spending, contract balances, money set aside but not yet spent, and funding risks, so a shortfall shows up before it affects the project
* Do the monthly budget and cost reconciliations across more than one funding source
* Work with the schedulers on cash flow and on how schedule changes affect cost
* Review financial reports and progress data, and tell the project managers about material variances and risks
* Track contract periods of performance, contract balances, and remaining funding
* Coordinate invoice review and reconciliation with accounting so payments go out on time and correct
* Keep the program controls databases, dashboards, and financial reports accurate
* Keep project documents, records, correspondence, and reports organized and current

  
**Requirements**

**What You Bring**

* 5 recent years in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, or a related field (required for this role)
* A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, sustainability, or a related field. Another way to qualify: 4 more years of the same experience, 9 years in all, takes the place of the degree
* Advanced Excel: complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial models, budget tracking, and reports (required for this role)
* Microsoft Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
* A large project management software system such as Proliance or Trimble Unity, or one like them (required for this role)
* Clear writing, careful analysis, good organization, and the ability to keep several projects and many people moving on your own

**Preferred**

* Capital projects inside a large public works or school construction program
* Cost management, forecasting, estimates to complete, and funding checks
* BuildLACCD or a similar program's financial controls, budgets, and project setup
* The DSA process (DSA is the state office that approves public school and college construction)
* Energy efficiency, renewable energy, electrification, or other sustainability projects
* Tableau or a similar tool for cost and performance reports

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation**

Salary range: $128,000 to $140,000 per year, based on experience.

Benefits: health, dental, and vision at low cost; 401k; three weeks of PTO; and an ESOP (employee stock ownership) at no cost to you, with a 3% Safe Harbor contribution vested on day one.

**Why MAAS**

MAAS has spent nearly 40 years earning the trust of 50+ educational institutions across California, managing over $10B in projects. That track record means the work here is stable, funded, and consequential. You are not chasing the next contract.

As a MAAS employee, you are also an owner. The company is 100% employee-owned through an ESOP, a retirement benefit provided at no cost to you, on top of your salary. MAAS is a profitable, well-run organization and our share price has more than doubled since the plan's inception, with continued growth year over year. Your ownership stake builds the longer you stay, and ESOP participants nationally tend to accumulate 2.5x more in retirement savings than employees at non-ESOP companies.

In an industry not known for prioritizing culture, 96% of MAAS employees say it is a great place to work, and 100% say people genuinely care about each other.

jobs.title: HUMAN TRAFFICKING COORDINATOR (PROGRAM SPECIALIST)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The City Manager’s Office is recruiting for a full-time, unclassified Human Trafficking Coordinator (Program Specialist). Under the supervision of the Deputy City Manager for Strategic Governance and Policy, this position will establish and lead the City’s new human trafficking and sexual exploitation focus area, addressing both sex and labor trafficking. It will also serve as the City’s centralized lead for implementing the R.E.A.C.T. Framework (Report, Economic Investment, Advocate, Community Budget, TriCity Partnership and LA County), coordinating interdepartmental and interjurisdictional efforts to address human trafficking along Long Beach Boulevard, citywide, and across the region.

This is a new position added in the FY 27 Budget and the City’s only position dedicated full time to addressing human trafficking. The position will work closely with City departments involved in this work, as well as community partners, service providers, and regional agencies, to coordinate efforts, strengthen partnerships, and make better use of data. The City Manager’s Office is responsible for the administration of all City government departments, except for elected offices and the semi-autonomous departments. This is a rewarding opportunity for a highly organized, self-motivated leader who can bring people together, build partnerships, and turn data into action in a fast-paced environment.

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES**
----------------------

* Serve as the City’s centralized lead and point of contact for implementation of the R.E.A.C.T. Framework and related interdepartmental and interjurisdictional anti-human trafficking efforts
* Convene and facilitate the City’s interdepartmental Anti-Human Trafficking Team, including setting agendas, tracking commitments, and following up on and supporting action items
* Work with partner departments, including Police, Health and Human Services, Community Development, the City Prosecutor, and the City Attorney, to develop work plans, timelines, and accountability measures, and to support related policies, programs, and ordinances
* Lead the development and implementation of City initiatives, such as public awareness campaigns and community workshops, including managing consultants and contracts, scopes of work and deliverables
* Identify gaps, overlaps, and barriers across City efforts, research promising practices from other jurisdictions, and recommend practical solutions to City leadership
* Inventory and assess data collected by the City and its partners, and recommend improvements to data collection, sharing, and analysis
* Develop performance measures, analyze trends, and track the progress and outcomes of City efforts
* Prepare clear reports, memos, City Council items, and presentations for City leadership, the City Council, and the public
* Ensure the perspectives of survivors and people with lived experience inform City strategy, using a trauma-informed, survivor-centered approach
* Build and sustain partnerships and coalitions with nonprofits, survivor-serving organizations, community groups, businesses, schools, and faith-based organizations
* Coordinate with neighboring cities, Los Angeles County, regional and local human trafficking task forces, and State and Federal partners on shared strategies
* In coordination with the Office of Government Affairs (OGA), track State and Federal legislation and funding opportunities related to human trafficking and help develop recommended City positions
* Identify grant opportunities and assist with grant applications, administration, and reporting
* Manage the program budget, track expenditures, resources, and funding sources, and ensure funds are used effectively and in compliance with City requirements
* Represent the City at community meetings, task forces, and public events
* Respond to City Council and community inquiries related to the City’s anti-human trafficking efforts
* May assist with other related duties

**REQUIREMENTS TO FILE**
------------------------

**EDUCATION**

* A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university with a major in Public Administration, Public Policy, Social Work, Criminal Justice, Public Health, Political Science, or a related field \*must provide proof of degree. OR
* Experience offering specific and substantial preparation for the duties of the position may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis.

**EXPERIENCE**

* Two (2) years of full-time equivalent professional experience in program coordination, policy development, or community partnerships, preferably in public safety, public health, social services, or local government.
* A Master’s Degree in one of the preceding fields may be substituted for one year of the required experience. \*must provide proof of degree

Required documents, such as transcripts and degrees, must be uploaded to the online application in PDF format at the time of filing. Any proofs submitted must contain either the applicant’s name or other identifying characteristics on the document.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

The ideal candidate is a skilled organizer, facilitator, and leader with the people savvy to bring departments and partners together around shared goals and keep complex work moving forward. They understand that partner departments carry full workloads and know how to support them by researching, drafting, and taking on the execution of shared efforts where appropriate. They will bring a track record of moving multi-agency or multidisciplinary initiatives from plan to results, along with the relationship-building skills to earn the trust of City departments, elected officials, nonprofits, survivors, and community members alike.

As this is a new position, the ideal candidate will be energized by building a program from the ground up. They are highly organized, self-directed, and proactive. They set priorities, track their own progress, keep leadership informed, and push work forward with

jobs.title: Creative Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Creative Development Coordinator  
**DEPARTMENT:** Content – TV & Film  
**REPORTS TO:** SVP, Netflix Features & ABC Series  
**LOCATION:** Los Angeles/Hybrid

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Creative Development Coordinator will administratively support a busy senior executive on active current television series and help the features team as they build out the slate. Duties will extend to operating as a hub for targeted department lists, grids, and key documents and evaluating material for Shondaland’s development pipeline with keen awareness of the company’s global brand.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

  

* Coordinates and schedules notes calls, production calls, pitches, general meetings, work meals, etc. - acting as liaison across various internal departments, production, partners, agents, managers, and studio.
* Rolls calls and tracks dynamic phone sheets, coordinates travel, manages calendars, updates contact lists, schedules conference room reservations, books meal reservations, handles technology updates and troubleshooting, researches and implements new organizational systems for SVP, and performs various administrative tasks as they arise.
* Logs submissions, as well as notes on said submissions. Tracks responses to submitted material, ensuring that the executive has responded to them in a timely manner. Manages outgoing material log.
* Remains up-to-date and always prepared to discuss coverage on all materials, including story areas, outlines, and drafts for current projects and projects in development, as well as cuts of current projects. As well, actively reads and shares thoughts on spec scripts, books, and other submitted material in a timely manner. Manages distribution of relevant project materials to both internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensures a clear and efficient operations by keeping the SVP aware of all relevant matters including, but not limited to, attendees’ credits in advance of meetings, invitations to events and speaking engagements, coverage and status on submitted materials (writing & directing samples, specs, pitch decks, books, music, acting reels, articles, etc.), new outlines, revised drafts, anything timely and/or outstanding to be addressed.
* Actively oversees showrunner, writer, director, and talent lists for specific projects with both new ideas, as well as ideas submitted by the rest of the development team. Checks availability with representatives and has all priority lists and grids at the ready for Content Team executives. Actively supports staffing needs on a project-by-project basis by: a) sample reading/gridding or b) helping find support staff/assistants for the writers’ room.
* As invited, works alongside Shondaland executives and EPs/creatives to: a) prepare and refine pitches and contributing to overall strategy, b) contribute on-target ideas to project-specific writer/director/talent lists, c) assess submissions for possible future projects, flagging material Shondaland executives need to consider, d) actively seek out and identify potential new business through available material for scripted series with an eye to future staffing possibilities, and e) join targeted general meetings with writers, directors and executives to build relationships, earmark future potential business opportunities, continue growing Shondaland brand awareness and communicating targets for development.
* Ensures that both active project grids and project Google Drive folders remain up to date as material goes both into NFLX and wide to internal teams.
* Procures screeners, scripts and other pertinent reference information as needed.

  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS and ABILITIES**

* Exceptional analysis, coverage and organizational abilities
* Work on feature film projects a plus
* Demonstrated ability to quickly develop internal and external relationships at all levels
* Equal ability to assess both drama and comedy projects
* Strong awareness of and appreciation for the Shondaland brand and mission
* Meticulous discretion
* Creative problem-solving and ability to anticipate needs
* Experience with research and creating presentation materials
* Network of contacts at talent agencies and management companies
* Go get ‘em attitude - no task too big or too small.

  

**POSITION QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Technical fluency required; ability to adapt to new technologies essential
* Minimum 3 years’ full-time, paid experience in the entertainment industry
* Previous work on a high-volume desk is strongly preferred
* Ability to work flexible hours, as needed

  

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**  
This position is deemed to be and have the following requirements: Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**POSITION TITLE:** **EVENT OPERATIONS** **COORDINATOR**

  

**On board experiential marketing**

OBE is a global marketing agency that brings brands to life through culture-shaping experiences. For more than 30 years, we've partnered with iconic brands — including Nike, the NFL, JPMorganChase, Meta, Sephora, Starbucks, and Converse — to build community, create cultural relevance, and drive measurable business impact. With offices in Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, and London, we activate globally. OBE is also a founding member of The ADD Collective, extending our reach and resources while staying true to our core capabilities.

  

We've been recognized by Event Marketer as one of the best places to work in events — and we couldn't agree more.

  

The most important part of our business is our people. They are hardworking, imaginative, and make genuinely remarkable things happen. But behind every great activation is a human who deserves rest, connection, and a life outside of work. That's why we invest in recovery days, company offsites, happy hours, and the kind of friendly-but-competitive fitness challenges that bond teams for life.

* Provides direct supervision of team members including scheduling and time keeping.
* Ensures that billing is reviewed and approved by clients, and advises the Director and/or Sales Manager of any potential challenges.

jobs.title: Member Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**

The Anti-Recidivism Coalition (ARC) works to end mass incarceration. To ensure our communities

are safe, healthy, and whole, ARC empowers formerly and currently incarcerated people to thrive

by providing a support network, comprehensive reentry services, and opportunities to advocate

for policy change. Through our grassroots policy advocacy, we are dedicated to transforming the

criminal justice system so that it is more just and equitable for all people.

**Position Summary**

The Membership Events Coordinator serves to connect ARC members to the many programs and

opportunities offered by ARC and the broader community. This position plays a critical role in

facilitating member engagement in monthly support meetings, weekly programming, public

speaking opportunities, and other ARC and community events.

The Membership Events Coordinator actively plans and participates in ARC-sponsored events and

serves as a role model encouraging members to get involved in the community. This position also

supports all staff in communicating information to members.

**ESSENTIAL POSITION FUNCTIONS :**

Responsibilities related to the ARC Member Engagement include, but are not limited to, the following:

* Oversee the execution of extra-curricular member engagement activities such as: sporting and community events, and conferences.
* Organize and oversee the implementation of key member engagement activities including Wolf Connection, River Rafting, Catalina Island visit, and the Annual Member Retreat (and all virtual retreats).
* Lead outreach to ARC members across programs for all ARC community events, including advocacy and community organizing events.
* Plan and execute Monthly Member Support meetings.
* Cultivate and expedite volunteer opportunities for ARC members with a minimum of one volunteer event per month.
* Create systems for ongoing member outreach to increase attendance at weekly ARC support groups and activities.
* Work closely with all ARC Programs (Housing, Member Services) to ensure smooth and consistent communications about member needs.
* Create systems for tracking attendance and setting goals for member engagement throughout the year.
* Actively engage ARC community on the internal ARC Facebook page by posting group activities, volunteer and employment opportunities and serve as the main point of contact for getting information to ARC members.
* Capture video and photo content at member events to post on ARC’s social media channels.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with community organizing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Adobe Creative Suite and knowledge of social media outlets (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram).
* Ability to work well in a team environment.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to multitask and/or willingness to learn to multitask.
* Leadership characteristics and excellent communication skills (written and verbal, comfortable with public speaking), along with an upbeat and outgoing personality.
* Reliable vehicle and valid driver license.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as needed.
* Engaging and outgoing personality
* Must have proof of being fully vaccinated, including booster, if eligible.
* Physically active - ability to carry/lift up to 10 pounds
* Reliable vehicle and valid drivers license
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including some evenings and weekends, as needed.

**Salary/Benefits**

* Pay rate is $28.85 - $31.25 D.O.E.
* Medical, dental, vision benefits
* Employer-funded life insurance
* Paid vacation and sick leave

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

***ARC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or any other category protected by local, state, or federal laws. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive staff team. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ, women, trans and gender non-conforming people, people with disabilities; and/or formerly incarcerated people.***

jobs.description:
**Sales Coordinator**

**Anderson Bradshaw Consulting**

**Starting Base Salary:** $60,000–$65,000 per year, based on relevant experience

**Schedule:** Full-time, Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m.Location: 7462 N. Figueroa Street, Suite 104, Los Angeles, CA 90041 — Eagle Rock

**Work Setting:** In person

**Work Location**: In person

**About the Company**

Anderson Bradshaw Consulting is an established tax resolution firm helping individuals and businesses navigate serious IRS and tax problems. Our sales and service teams work together to help clients understand their next steps and move forward with their tax matters.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Sales Coordinator to work directly with the Director of Sales as the primary in-office support for our sales team. You will help incoming opportunities reach the right salesperson, keep CRM follow-up moving, and reconnect with older leads that may still need our services.

Your day will combine live phone coverage with proactive outreach and lead coordination. Incoming calls take priority; between calls, you will work CRM leads, follow up with salespeople, and recover opportunities that have stalled or gone untouched.

**Entry Level Medical Sales Representative – Nationwide Travel | $73K Base + Bonus**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Company:** Skilled Wound Care  
**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (Field-Based, Extensive Overnight Travel: 4–5 Days per Week)  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | Entry Level  
**Salary:** $73,000 Base Salary + Uncapped Bonus Potential  
**Industry:** Healthcare Sales | Medical Sales | Wound Care | Skilled Nursing & Long-Term Care

### **Launch Your Medical Sales Career With Paid Training and Mentorship**

Skilled Wound Care is hiring an Entry Level Medical Sales Representative (Business Development Associate) for a nationwide, field-based travel role. If you're a recent college graduate or early-career professional who wants to break into healthcare sales, this role gives you structured sales training, mentorship from senior sales leaders, and a clear path to a full closing role.

No medical sales experience required. We're looking for drive, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

At Skilled Wound Care, we don't just fill roles. We build partnerships, and our culture is the foundation of everything we do. You'll join a team that pushes each other to grow, shows up for one another, and shares in each other's wins. We work hard, we have fun doing it, and we believe a great culture isn't a perk. It's how we operate every day.

### **Why Start Your Healthcare Sales Career at Skilled Wound Care?**

* **Competitive entry-level pay:** a $73,000 base salary plus bonus potential that grows as you start closing accounts.
* **Mentorship from senior sales leaders:** you're never alone. Your challenges become our challenges, and your wins become our wins.
* **Clear career path:** we develop leaders from within, and many of our senior closers started right where you are.
* **Your voice matters:** your ideas carry weight, and you help build the vision, not just carry it out.
* **Integrity-first sales culture:** no shortcuts and no pressure tactics. We win the right way.
* **Full sales cycle exposure:** hands-on experience in B2B healthcare sales within the Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) and Long-Term Care (LTC) industry.

### **What You'll Do as a Business Development Associate**

* **Prospecting and sales support:** learn and help with prospecting, outreach, lead generation, and relationship-building with Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Long-Term Care facilities nationwide, working alongside experienced closers.
* **Territory development:** help identify target accounts and learn how territory management and national market expansion strategy come together in the field.
* **Consultative and clinical value selling:** learn to explain the ROI of our physician-led wound care model to facility administrators, owners, and other decision-makers. Training and coaching are provided.
* **Relationship management:** build your own professional network with SNF staff, facility owners, and regional directors, mentored by senior team members.
* **Team collaboration:** share field insights, ask questions, and contribute to a team sales strategy that lifts everyone.

### **About the Travel: A True Road Warrior Role**

This is a **field-based medical sales role with extensive nationwide travel**. Expect to be on the road **4–5 days per week, including overnight stays**, visiting Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) and Long-Term Care facilities in markets across the United States.

This role is a great fit if you:

* Enjoy being in the field, face-to-face with customers, rather than behind a desk
* Like a fast-paced schedule where every week looks different

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Vector Atomic:**

Vector Atomic, an IonQ company, is building quantum technology to transform navigation, timing, geophysical exploration, and telecommunications. Our team of engineers, scientists, software developers, and operations professionals works together to solve complex challenges and turn bold ideas into real-world solutions. We value collaboration, curiosity, and diverse perspectives, and we give every team member the opportunity to make an immediate impact while growing their skills. If you're excited to work on breakthrough technology in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we'd love to hear from you.

We are seeking a hands-on **Project Coordinator** to assist with project management and scheduling, as well as contract administration. To support challenging technical goals, you will take ownership of, and create streamlined processes for, management, tracking, and delivery of programmatic requirements. Working closely with executive leadership and the overall team, your responsibilities will include: (a) program support for Principal Investigators, including report creation and submission, project scheduling/tracking, and program management; (b) taking possession of contract review and administration; (c) distill and convey complex ideas to technical and general audiences; (d) adding structure and efficient processes to our organization while maintaining our get-it-done culture. The ideal candidate is unafraid to dive into new concepts, can handle and prioritize multiple tasks, and has broad experience generating high-quality written and presentation materials.
  
  
**Location: This role is based onsite at our office in Pleasanton, CA (Bay Area)**

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Do**

* Work with a team of physicists and engineers to help synthesize and refine content for the target audience
* Create and edit content, including figures, images, and diagrams, for contract deliverables (e.g., monthly and/or quarterly reports – primarily PPT-based)
* Support kickoff, interim, and final review meetings through content creation/scheduling
* Provide scheduling/organization function via weekly deliverable tracker + Project Management software (Smartsheet and Jira)
* Participate in internal and external team calls/meetings/visits
* Contract review (flow down requirements/assist with revision requests/etc.) and tracking; distill and convey requirements to technical team
* Support accounting through creation/submission of invoices
* Contribute to final reports and proposals

**What We're Looking For:**

* To comply with the US export control laws, Vector Atomic employees must be U.S. citizens (born or naturalized), lawful U.S. permanent residents (i.e. green card holders), and certain categories of refugees, and asylees.
* Strong time management, organizational, problem-solving and analytical skills; able to manage priorities and workflow
* Ability to comb through and edit complex technical details and jargon
* Strong interpersonal skills; discuss/refine complex ideas; negotiate personalities/styles to achieve the best product
* Strong attention to detail; pride in work product
* Proactive; looks for opportunities to make the organization and their co-workers better
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and deliver high quality work while managing multiple deadlines

 **Benefits**

Vector Atomic values teamwork, open and honest discourse, and work-life balance. We offer competitive compensation and benefits including:

* Platinum-level family health coverage (medical, dental, vision)
* Health and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Employer 401(k) contributions
* 20 days of paid time off & 11 paid holidays
* Paid parental leave
* Fully stocked kitchen

**Pay Range**

The approximate base salary range for this position is $80,000 to $120,000 per year. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity and benefits. It's atypical to be hired at the top end of this range for the role, as actual pay is based on several factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience level.

*Vector Atomic is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law.*

*Vector Atomic does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.*

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**

The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.  
  
**Title:****Program Coordinator - YAWL Young Adult Job Centers**

**Salary:****$30.00 - $34.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full-Time, (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt**  
  
**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16-24. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  
  
**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Young Adult Job Center portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.  
  
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Cultivate relationships with employers, developing jobs for youth and young adults.
* Support agency-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination and development.
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs

CYC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, age, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other basis recognized by federal, state, or local law, including on the basis of the intersection of two or more protected characteristics, also known as intersectional discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

**Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Ability to interact, internally, and with clients, at various organizational levels.

* Ability to connect with others authentically while equally honoring and respecting diverse perspectives.

**Other Qualities and Skills**

**Compensation Range:** $70,304 - $77,652 annually. This is the pay range OBE believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. **About the Company:**

GreenWaste has been an industry leader in recycling and waste diversion for 40 years and is on a growth trajectory after private equity investment in 2021. Our business was founded on principles of environmental sustainability, and innovation is a cornerstone of our ongoing operations and growth strategy. GreenWaste specializes in all aspects of material collection, processing, and sales, tailoring our service offerings to the unique needs of our customers and communities, and helping to shape the evolution of the solid waste and recycling industry. We work directly with 20+ municipalities and 50+ jurisdictions, operate highly regulated facilities in 10+ locations, and have 1,000+ employees.

**Position** **Summary:**

The Environmental Outreach Coordinator delivers outreach and education across assigned jurisdictions to support community engagement, regulatory compliance, and waste-diversion goals. Up to sixty percent of the role is spent in the field, conducting waste audits by inspecting residential carts and commercial waste and recycling containers to assess sorting practices, identify contamination, and support diversion efforts. The Coordinator also educates residents and businesses on proper waste sorting and diversion practices, participates in community events, and delivers presentations to schools, community groups, and other audiences. Assignments may span multiple jurisdictions based on contract and operational requirements.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

Waste Audits & Field Assessments

* Conduct in-person field audits by inspecting residential carts and commercial and multi-family waste, recycling, and organics containers to assess sorting practices, contamination, and compliance.
* Perform on-site assessments to identify contamination, service issues, and opportunities to improve waste diversion and proper sorting.
* Document and submit audit findings in accordance with contract and program requirements.

Program Implementation

* Carry out outreach and education activities required under applicable contract service agreements.
* Support implementation of waste reduction, reuse, recycling, and organics programs.
* Complete required outreach, education, tracking, and follow-up activities in accordance with program and contract requirements.

Customer Education & Outreach

* Provide on-site education and training to residents, businesses, and other customers regarding proper sorting, contamination reduction, waste diversion, and program requirements
* Deliver educational presentations to schools, community groups, businesses, and civic organizations.
* Conduct facility tours for schools, community groups, and other stakeholders.

Community Events & Engagement

* Coordinate logistics, materials, and staffing for community outreach events.
* Represent GreenWaste at community events, workshops, and public meetings.
* Develop interactive activities and distribute educational materials.

Outreach Logistics & Coordination

* Organize materials, transportation, and scheduling for field and outreach activities.
* Maintain tour equipment, outreach supplies, and event materials.
* Coordinate with operations, customer service, municipal partners, and other internal and external stakeholders as needed.

Collateral & Communications

* Develop flyers, signage, newsletters, and other outreach materials in collaboration with the communications team.
* Assist with website updates and maintain current, accessible educational materials.
* Support translation and localization of outreach materials as needed.

Reporting & Data Collection

* Maintain accurate records of field audits, outreach activities, events, presentations, and customer interactions.
* Compile and submit required program and contract reporting, including applicable outreach and engagement metrics.
* Track program progress, recurring contamination issues, customer education needs, challenges, and outcomes.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**:

* Ability and willingness to conduct field inspections of residential carts and commercial waste, recycling, and organics containers to assess contents, identify contamination, and evaluate proper sorting.
* Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to educate customers and present information effectively to groups.
* Ability to engage residents, businesses, schools, and community organizations in waste reduction, recycling, organics, and proper sorting practices.
* Ability to promote programs with enthusiasm, creativity, and a solutions‑oriented mindset.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, andability to accurately document field observations and outreach activities.
* Ability to work independently in the field and collaboratively with internal teams, municipal partners, customers, and community stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel; graphic design skills preferred.

**Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, public policy, communications, business, or a related field or a minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience in environmental outreach, waste and recycling programs, community engagement, or a related field.
* Valid California driver’s license, a clean driving recordand ability to travel between assigned facilities, customer locations, and jurisdictions.

**Language Skill:**

* Proficiency in English, bi-lingual Spanish is a plus

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to lift and carry materials weighing up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to frequently stand and walk and to bend, reach, and move as needed to visually inspect residential carts and commercial waste, recycling, and organics containers.
* Ability to perform fieldwork and participate in outdoor community events for extended periods.
* Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) while performing field inspections and other designated activities.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Transportation Planning and Management Division (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility and markings, and ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
Research, Implementation, and Safety unit (RIS) is a multi-disciplinary team dedicated to making the streets of New York City safer for all users as part of Vision Zero, a citywide policy striving to eliminate serious injuries and fatalities from traffic crashes. School Safety, a unit within RIS, is responsible for improving safety near K-12 schools throughout New York City. The group redesigns streets next to schools with a goal of reducing child injuries, improving safety and accessibility, and encouraging non-motorized transportation in all five boroughs. School Safety advises NYC agencies and private parties on school siting and various policy and street design issues related to youth safety and school operations. The unit manages all curb regulations and signage next to NYC K-12 schools, including the School Slow Zone program.
  
  
Under the direction of senior staff and with wide latitude for independent judgment, the candidate will be responsible for planning, developing, designing, and implementing Street Improvement Projects (SIPs) to improve safety for all roadway users with a particular emphasis on child safety, in order to advance the goals of the NYC Streets Plan and the Vision Zero Action Plan. This role will involve project management, extensive community outreach, research, data analysis, implementation coordination, and field work.
  
  
The selected candidate will analyze crash and traffic data; create street designs using AutoCAD; coordinate with staff throughout DOT and partner city agencies; perform extensive community outreach to schools, elected officials, Community Boards, inter-and intra-agency members, and other stakeholders; develop and deliver public presentations; and manage implementation of new roadway designs. Outreach work with students in NYC schools may be required on some of the projects. Additionally, the candidate will have the opportunity to investigate new design treatments and policy initiatives, to develop and pilot innovative safety treatments, and to develop new capital projects for implementation by the Department of Design and Construction on behalf of NYC DOT School Safety. The candidate will also coordinate research efforts; participate in technical and advisory committee meetings; and work with DOT staff and external agency representatives on studies and projects.
  
  
Additional tasks may include reviewing community requests as related to school safety and operations in NYC. Furthermore, the candidate will help the team deliver on the ambitious goal of Mayor Mamdani’s administration to install a 15-mile-per-hour school slow zone next to every K-12 school in NYC by the end of 2029 and assist with planning and coordination tasks associated with the School Slow Zone program.
  
  
The Department of Transportation's (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents.

jobs.description:
**About the Alpha Engine Department**

The Alpha Engine is responsible for Pure Alpha, Bridgewater’s flagship alpha strategy launched in 1991. Our aim in Pure Alpha is to generate high and consistent returns, uncorrelated to markets and other managers over time. We pursue this by systematically deploying our fundamental understanding of markets and economies to trade long, short, and relative value across roughly 200 liquid public markets.

**About Your Role**

The Investor Talent team partners with investors across Bridgewater’s investment departments on how the firm identifies, assesses, develops, and compensates its investors, at a time of significant change for the firm. The team is building as it goes, which leaves real room to shape how things run.

The Program Coordinator role is an execution-focused role at the center of how the Investor Talent team runs. You’ll work directly with the team's manager, leads, and senior investors, bringing tight execution and project management skills to translate priorities into practical plans and drive investor programs from planning through delivery. Your book of work will shift with the calendar, with management of the team's operations and programs taking up the majority of your time during peak periods.

We are a nimble, hands-on team where every member contributes to the operational work through to the outcomes that make our programs successful (e.g., attending the events that you help shape and plan). We’re looking for someone who takes pride in getting the details right, follows through reliably, and is equally willing to coordinate calendars, pull ongoing metrics, or improve and own a process. It’s a fast-moving environment with a lot to learn, so curiosity and adaptability will go a long way. Over time, the right person will take on broader project management ownership, improve how our programs run, and manage increasingly complex workstreams.

You will drive the following responsibilities:

* **Primary partner in running a tight talent ecosystem:** Partner with the team’s manager and leads to understand the broad mission of investor talent, and own coordination at the goal level rather than the task level. In practice, this means owning the calendar, meeting logistics, agendas, and program sessions and materials, and anticipating needs before you’re asked.
* **Owner of the team’s management machines:** Build, run, and continuously improve the recurring processes that keep the team operating, including review cycles, security, and operations. Keep meetings, follow-ups, and commitments on track across these processes. Own knowledge management across SharePoint, Confluence, and distribution lists, with room to shape how it works and evolves.
* **Project manager for key programs:** Own day-to-day execution of the summer internship and investor class, from scheduling and communications to materials and events. Translate priorities into clear plans with timelines, owners, and dependencies, and adapt as needs change. Anticipate risks, resolve bottlenecks, and hold stakeholders accountable to their commitments, escalating with sound judgment when needed. Track engagement metrics to assess how well each program is working.
* **Key driver of technology and AI to raise team productivity:** Use technology and AI to improve how the team works, from automating coordination and communications to streamlining reviews and programs. Proactively look for ways to run things better, and connect the dots across workstreams so improvements spread.

The Police Athletic League (PAL) of New York City is an independent youth development nonprofit organization and has been a vibrant and vital institution, serving as an effective, critical bridge between police and communities across all five boroughs of the City since 1914. PAL operates diverse programs for children as young as 2 years old to young adults. Programs include Head Start, after-school programs and summer day camps for elementary, middle and high school youth, and summer Playstreets. PAL also runs evening teen centers and college readiness programs, youth employment, and juvenile justice programs. Staying true to PAL’s roots, a cornerstone of our youth development strategy includes offering competitive and recreational sports for children of all ages. At PAL, we’re devoted to empowering communities and building the best places to work, and that goes for our own teams too.

Position Summary

The HEAF Outreach Coordinator supports the daily operations of PAL's HEAF program at the Harlem Center, serving middle and high school students in grades 6–12. Responsibilities include coordinating program activities, maintaining student records and attendance, managing schedules, supporting events, and communicating with students and families.

The position also supports student recruitment, family engagement, and community outreach while helping connect students to academic enrichment, college access, career exploration, and leadership opportunities. Working under the direction of the HEAF Program Director, the Outreach Coordinator helps ensure students and families remain informed, engaged, and connected to program resources.

* Schedule: 10 hours per week
* Salary: $30 per hour

Major Duties & Responsibilities

* Program Support: Assist with the coordination of daily program activities, schedules, student rosters, attendance, and general program needs.
* Student and Family Communication: Communicate with students and families regarding program schedules, activities, events, attendance, and important updates. Assist with follow-up when students are absent.
* Outreach and Recruitment: Assist with student recruitment, enrollment, and outreach to local schools, families, and community organizations to promote program participation.
* Events and Activities: Help organize workshops, college tours, family activities, and special events, including coordinating sign-ups and collecting required permission forms.
* Administrative Support: Maintain attendance records and student documentation, assist with routine administrative tasks, and provide program updates to the HEAF Program Director.
* Other duties as assigned.

What You Bring:

* High school diploma required. Associate’s degree or higher in a relevant human services field preferred.
* 1-2 years of community outreach, youth development or other relevant experience required.
* Demonstrated skills and competency in culturally relevant approaches and youth development.
* Non-judgmental approach and ability to empathize with others.
* Demonstrated experience establishing and maintaining community partnerships.
* Experience working in an ethnically, culturally and racially diverse environment.
* Ability to collaborate as part of a team.
* Leadership skills in conflict intervention, negotiation, decision-making, and delegation.
* Dynamic energy, able to multi-task and negotiate multiple requests.
* Committed to working toward positive community change.
* Strong communication skills, both oral and written. Ability to speak effectively and persuasively to staff, members, parents, groups, and community residents.

City Harvest is New York’s first and largest food rescue organization and a fast-paced, high-performing nonprofit dedicated to helping feed millions of New Yorkers who struggle to put meals on their tables. jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant, Faculty serves as the primary source of administrative support for two research

groups and their leaders and will be responsible for varied tasks supporting biomedical academic research labs.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Manages complex calendars of group leaders.
* Schedules meetings, conference calls and interviews, responds to invitations, reserves locations, manages attendee lists etc.
* Works through scheduling roadblocks using independent judgment and discretion  
  wherever possible.
* Ensures group leaders are prepared for meetings and assists them with best managing

their time.

* Coordinates events, meetings and conferences, including A/V needs, catering, confirming attendees, booking locations, etc.
* Coordinates extensive travel arrangements. Prepares itineraries and documents to facilitate

domestic and international travel by group members and job candidates.

* Prepares and processes expense reimbursements and tracks outstanding expenses.
* Maintains and updates group websites as papers are published and grants are funded.
* Supports group leaders when they are teaching, e.g. organizes the course calendar, arranges meetings with students, maintains the course website.

Performs other administrative duties as requested, such as;

* Proofreads, reviews and edits documents with excellent attention to detail.
* Attends meetings to take notes, tracking action items and following up accordingly.
* Liaises with students and administrators at NYGC and other NY institutes (primarily Columbia University and NYU), for example to set up new hires, secure space, order computers and materials.
* Orders office supplies.
* Performs filing, scanning and record-keeping.
* Provides administrative support (if other priorities permit) to other NYGC faculty on an occasional basis, as a backup for other administrative staff.

**Position Requirements**

* 2+ years of administrative experience, including calendar maintenance;
* Strong writing and editing skills and excellent attention-to-detail;
* Excellent competence with computers and modern communication tools, such MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel), Slack, Gemini/ChatGPT;
* Exceptional time management and organizational skills, with the ability to appropriately balance multiple, competing priorities;
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
* Ability to anticipate needs and take action without requiring detailed direction in relation to routine responsibilities;
* Ability to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and to engender trust;
* Experience working in an academic, scientific or non-profit environment preferred; and, undergraduate degree preferred.

**About the Sanjana Lab**

The Sanjana Lab develops technologies to understand how human genetic variants cause diseases. The lab employs a multi-disciplinary approach, combining genome engineering, pooled genetic screens, molecular genomics, synthetic biology, and imaging, to dissect the inner workings of the human genome and to develop next-generation therapies for diverse diseases, including cancer, rare inherited disorders, brain disorders, autoimmunity and others. The Sanjana lab is comprised of molecular engineers, biologists, neuroscientists, computer scientists and bioscience entrepreneurs who are passionate about creating new technologies for genomics and advancing human health. The lab is also affiliated with the Department of Biology at New York University. http://sanjanalab.org/

**About the Phatnani Lab**

The Phatnani Lab applies integrated multi-omic approaches to understand the molecular mechanisms underlying neurodegenerative diseases. The lab employs a multi-disciplinary approach, combining whole-genome sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, single-nucleus epigenomics and RNA-seq, and multiplex protein imaging, to dissect the complex interplay between neurons and non-neuronal cells in the brain and spinal cord, to study diseases including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal dementia (FTD), and other neurodegenerative disorders. The Phatnani lab is comprised of computational biologists and basic scientists who are passionate about building tools and resources for the research community and advancing our understanding of human brain health. The lab is affiliated with the Department of Neurology at Columbia University. https://www.nygenome.org/science-technology/faculty-labs/phatnani-lab/

  

**Competencies**

* Technical and Professional Skills: Consistently demonstrates skills and knowledge relevant for current role; strives to expand the depth and breadth of technical and professional skills; works with a high level of integrity; exhibits focus and discipline; appropriately prioritizes, manages expectations and delivers on commitments.
* Collaborative & Communicative: Models collaboration and teamwork; brings out the best in others; effectively works with all levels, internally and externally; respects and embraces diversity of perspective; communicates clearly and listens carefully; uses good judgment as to what to communicate and when to do so.
* Adaptable & Innovative: Adaptable and embraces change; develops new insights and pursues improvements and efficiency; fosters exchange of new ideas and willing to challenge the status quo; takes initiative and is solution-oriented; engages in work with passion and curiosity.

**Work Location**

This position is based onsite at the New York Genome Center.

**Salary & Benefits**

The pay range for this position is $70,000-80,000 per year; the base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition, NYGC offers a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits as well as generous time off. This includes Medical/Dental/Vision for employees & dependent(s); Vacation, Holidays, Sick, and Other Leave, including a paid winter break; a 401(k) match; Life Insurance; Flexible Spending Accounts; employee Tuition

jobs.description:
Authority Brands Inc. is a leading provider of home services, building brands that support the success of our franchisees, as well as bettering the lives of the homeowners we serve and the people we employ.
  
  
The Procurement Coordinator reports to the Director of Strategic Sourcing and provides administrative, analytical, sourcing, implementation, and supplier-management support across the Direct and Indirect Procurement teams.
  
Working closely with Category Managers, franchisees, Brand and Central Operations, Finance, Legal, suppliers, and other cross-functional stakeholders, this role coordinates procurement activities, maintains accurate project and supplier information, supports sourcing events, and helps move awarded programs from contract execution through implementation.
  
The Procurement Coordinator serves as a central point of coordination for procurement documentation, timelines, reporting, stakeholder communications, supplier onboarding, and program adoption. The role is expected to manage multiple priorities with accuracy, follow-through, and a strong service orientation.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Provide day-to-day project coordination and administrative support to the Direct and Indirect Procurement teams across active sourcing, implementation, and supplier-management initiatives.
* Maintain procurement project plans, sourcing calendars, action logs, savings trackers, implementation schedules, supplier records, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and other competitive sourcing events, including supplier communications, document distribution, question tracking, response collection, meeting scheduling, and evaluation-material preparation.
* Assist Category Managers with spend-data collection, supplier research, bid normalization, pricing comparisons, market research, and preparation of sourcing recommendations.
* Coordinate stakeholder meetings, supplier presentations, evaluation sessions, implementation calls, and business reviews; document decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.
* Support supplier onboarding and program implementation, including collection of required documentation, stakeholder communications, training coordination, enrollment tracking, issue logging, and follow-up with suppliers and internal teams.
* Maintain contract and supplier information, including executed agreements, pricing exhibits, service exhibits, renewal dates, termination-notice requirements, insurance documentation, and key supplier contacts.
* Assist with reporting for addressable spend, contracted spend, supplier utilization, savings, franchisee participation, implementation progress, and supplier performance.
* Support franchisee and internal stakeholder inquiries by routing questions, coordinating responses, tracking open issues, and maintaining frequently used program information.
* Prepare procurement presentations, status reports, meeting materials, and communications in support of category initiatives and leadership updates.
* Help maintain consistent procurement processes, templates, file structures, naming conventions, and documentation standards across the Direct and Indirect Procurement teams.
* Handle procurement and supplier information with appropriate confidentiality and escalate timeline, documentation, supplier, or stakeholder risks to the responsible Category Manager.
* Support broader procurement and supply-chain initiatives as required.

Qualifications
  
The Procurement Coordinator will have experience supporting procurement, supply chain, project coordination, operations, finance, or a related business function and will be comfortable working across multiple priorities in a decentralized organization.
  

* 0-3 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, project coordination, operations, finance, vendor management, or a related business function.
* Experience coordinating projects, meetings, documentation, timelines, and follow-up activities involving multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to organize and analyze supplier, pricing, spend, and project information with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate professionally with suppliers, franchisees, and stakeholders at varying organizational levels.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and escalate risks or issues appropriately.
* Experience preparing presentations, status reports, trackers, and other business documentation.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Ability to use AI as a support tool while maintaining ownership and understanding of the content produced.
* Comfort presenting in working sessions and team meetings.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, finance, operations, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

As an on-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with Asset’s policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

* *Affordable Housing Accreditation (HCCP, HCP-E, COS, BOS, TCS, CPO) or other applicable designations in affordable programs is preferred but not required.*

* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, and contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager, Indoor
jobs.description:
Authority Brands Inc. is a leading provider of home services, building brands that support the success of our franchisees, as well as bettering the lives of the homeowners we serve and the people we employ.
  
  
**Summary:**  
The Content Manager leads the planning, creation, and management of content across an assigned portfolio of brands. This role turns brand strategies and customer insights into clear, engaging content for websites, email, social media, video, and other channels, while maintaining each brand’s distinct voice.
  
Working with Brand Strategy, Field Marketing, the Digital Center of Excellence, and agency partners, the Content Manager maintains an organized content calendar, ensures materials are accurate and consistent, and uses performance insights to improve content that supports customer engagement, demand generation, and franchisee needs.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Content Curation, Adaptation & Scaled Execution
  

* Partner with Brand Marketing to produce engaging consumer-facing content (video, photography, blog posts) for paid and organic media that drives website traffic and brand value.
* Leverage generative AI and creative production tools to rapidly scale assets for 7 brands, focusing on customization and iteration vs. heavy graphic design.
* Accelerate content by generating localized, seasonal, and audience-specific variations to maintain high content volume across targeted campaigns.

Field Support & Campaign Versioning
  

* Build and maintain an accessible library of marketing toolkits, empowering franchisees to execute local campaigns independently without needing dedicated design support.
* Adapt core brand campaigns to match local consumer nuances and franchisee needs.
* Gather real-time insights from franchisees and field teams regarding asset adoption and performance, continuously optimizing to improve customer engagement.

Local SEO & Content Technology Strategy
  

* Maintain hyper-local content that helps improve search visibility, local awareness, and overall brand value.
* Evaluate and implement emerging content automation platforms and generative AI tools to streamline asset distribution and field customization.
* Social Media: Manage social media content and planning for the brand, both on the corporate level as well as the franchisee, working to improve each location’s online social presence.

Qualifications & Skills
  

* 3–5 years of experience in content marketing or creative operations with hands-on experience deploying at national and local level.
* Content Storytelling & Lightweight Production: Strong copy-editing, video editing, and digital curation skills. Experience in Canva, Adobe, and Nano Banana preferred.
* Local SEO & Field Collaboration: Familiarity with local SEO best practices, location-based content strategies, and a track record of working directly with local operators or franchisees to deliver user-friendly content toolkits.

**Primary brand(s), portfolio, or enterprise scope:** Enterprise
  
**Location and travel expectations:** Atlanta, GA
  
  
We believe our greatest assets are our employees, we offer competitive salaries and a full benefits package to include, PTO, paid holidays, 401(k) and more.

Authority Brands Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
***Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.***

We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future. We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today.

Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action. We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision.

**Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage –****Apply Now**

**Get to Know the Opportunity:**

The Client Relationship Manager (CRM) is an individual contributor responsible for delivering a service strategy that meets or exceeds client expectations. Success in this role is measured through client satisfaction, retention, and plan optimization. The CRM builds trusted relationships with clients, provides consultative guidance on retirement plan strategy and investments, and leads cross-functional teams in delivering solutions that support client and participant needs.

***Candidates must reside in the Southeast region of the United States to effectively cover the assigned client territory. This position requires approximately 25–40% travel based on client and business needs.***

**The Contributions You’ll Make:**

* Build trust-based relationships with key client stakeholders, including senior executives, Treasury, Human Resources, Benefits, advisors, and third-party administrators (TPAs).
* Attend Plan Investment and Administrative Committee meetings, as appropriate.
* Analyze plan data and industry trends to develop strategic recommendations related to plan design, products, investments, and participant engagement.
* Lead Voya’s cross-functional service team in executing client strategies and reporting effectiveness against agreed-upon metrics.
* Drive client retention efforts and manage RFIs, RFPs, and benchmarking exercises for existing clients.
* Lead contract negotiations, including pricing strategy, contract preparation and execution, and appropriate Service Level Agreements.
* Use consultative engagement to understand clients’ labor and benefits strategies and align solutions to their needs.
* Partner with internal teams to establish implementation dates, define project scope and requirements, negotiate client project costs, and manage expectations regarding delivery timelines.
* Identify opportunities for organic growth and cross-sale of Voya products and solutions, working across the organization to develop, position, close, and implement appropriate solutions.
* Contribute to RFP responses and participate in the sales process for new Retirement business.
* Maintain a strong understanding of Voya’s offerings and present solutions to prospective clients in a way that clearly communicates Voya’s differentiated value proposition.

**Minimum Knowledge & Experience:**

* 6+ years of experience in client service relationship management for defined contribution plans.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent retirement services work experience.
* FINRA Series 6 or 7 and Series 63 licensing.
* Retirement industry experience.
* Strong understanding of tax-exempt retirement plans, along with a solid investment background.
* Strong client relationship management skills.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to travel approximately 25–40% of the time nationwide.

**Preferred Knowledge & Experience:**

* Experience supporting governmental or tax-exempt retirement plan clients.

**How This Role Aligns to Our Core Four:**

Voya’s Core Four reflect how we deliver for our customers and one another, and this role brings those expectations to life through trusted client relationships, thoughtful plan strategy, and disciplined execution.

* **Instill Customer Obsession:** Build trusted relationships with clients and translate their retirement, benefits, and participant needs into strategies and solutions that strengthen satisfaction, plan outcomes, and retention.
* **Transform with Automation/AI:** Use available automation, AI, and analytical capabilities responsibly to support plan analysis, identify trends, and make client and cross-functional processes more efficient.
* **Drive Higher Performance Through Our People:** Lead cross-functional service teams with clear priorities and shared accountability to execute client strategies and deliver against agreed-upon outcomes.
* **Execute on the Fundamentals:** Maintain disciplined execution across contracts, pricing, Service Level Agreements, implementation commitments, investment discussions, and other client deliverables.
