jobs.title: Delivery Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
This position works in person Monay–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m., across multiple Community Food Center and retail partner locations throughout the Atlanta area.

**Who We Are:**

The Atlanta Community Food Bank is committed to ending hunger in our community by leveraging food, dedicated people, and innovative solutions to ensure that no one has to worry about their next meal. Since 1979, we’ve provided vital resources to a growing network of nonprofit partners, including food pantries, community kitchens, childcare centers, night shelters, and senior centers. Today, we proudly serve over 700 partners across 29 counties in metro Atlanta and north Georgia, working together to create a hunger-free future.

**Where You’ll Work:**

Program / Division

**About the Role:**

The Delivery Operations Coordinator supports the daily transportation and delivery operations for the Atlanta Community Food Bank’s Community Food Centers across the Atlanta area. This position safely operates a non-CDL box truck to transport food, equipment, and materials between retail partners and assigned Community Food Center locations, ensuring timely and accurate deliveries.

The role includes completing vehicle inspections, coordinating pickup and delivery schedules, and communicating with retail partners and Community Food Center management. Strong time management, attention to safety and food handling practices, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment are essential.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Transportation & Delivery Operations**

* Safely operate a company box truck to transport food, equipment, and materials between retail partners and assigned Community Food Center locations.
* Complete timely pickups and deliveries according to established schedules and assigned routes.
* Plan and adjust routes as needed based on traffic, weather, construction, and other conditions to support safe and on-time deliveries.
* Load, unload, secure, and handle food and other materials safely and efficiently.
* Complete required pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections and promptly report maintenance, safety, or repair needs.
* Maintain accurate transportation, inspection, and delivery records.

**Retail Partner & Customer Service:**

* Provide professional, respectful, and responsive service to local retail partners during scheduled pickups.
* Communicate expected arrival times, delays, and other delivery updates with retail partners and Community Food Center management.
* Build positive working relationships with retail partners, neighbors, volunteers, and ACFB team members.
* Represent the Atlanta Community Food Bank professionally while interacting with community partners and the public.

**Food Safety & Compliance:**

* Follow all ACFB food safety policies and procedures to protect product quality and ensure food is safe for consumption.
* Follow federal, state, and local transportation requirements, Department of Transportation regulations, and ACFB safety policies.
* Maintain all required licenses, certifications, vehicle documentation, and training.
* Report accidents, incidents, hazards, damaged product, or other safety concerns promptly and accurately.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe vehicle and work environment.

**Community Food Center Operations:**

* Support the daily operations of assigned Community Food Centers by coordinating the timely movement of donated products and materials.
* Work collaboratively with Community Food Center management, volunteers, and team members to support efficient loading, unloading, and delivery activities.
* Provide direction to volunteers and team members supporting loading and unloading activities
* Assist with operational activities as needed to ensure Community Food Centers receive products and materials in a timely and organized manner.

**Key Competencies we look for in All our Food Bankers are:**

* Customer Focus
* Decision Making
* Accountability
* The Ability to Navigate Change

If you’re excited about this role and can clearly demonstrate these and the other skills named below, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!

**Skills your resume should demonstrate:**

* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record.
* Experience operating non-CDL vehicles (box truck experience preferred).
* Ability to safely load, unload, and handle cargo.
* Basic knowledge of safe driving and transportation safety practices.
* Ability to complete vehicle inspections and report maintenance or safety issues.
* Ability to operate (or learn to operate) an electric pallet jack.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to meet delivery schedules.
* Experience in a fast-paced logistics, warehouse, retail, or food service environment.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to follow food safety and workplace safety procedures.
* Ability to work independently and adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to safely lift, move, load, and unload materials as required.

**There may be some Physical Demands and Travel:**

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Employee is routinely required to lift and transport heavy items at waist level, up to 75 lbs
* Frequent bending, stooping, reaching, climbing and walking are required
* Required to operate equipment
* This position would normally have routine opportunities to alter physical position or change eye focus.
* Frequently operates in temperature conditions consistent with outside weather.
* Frequently transition between ambient and refrigerator /freezer temperatures.
* This position requires local travel on a daily basis including routine stops which require driver to load and unload truck contents

jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

  
In addition to the responsibilities listed below, this position is also responsible for beginning to coordinate department workflow; providing standard and nonstandard administrative support to senior leadership; coordinating intricate executive calendars and travel arrangements; notifying executive of issues that require immediate attention; anticipating the executives upcoming needs; drafting and distributing details of highly confidential with discretion and cautionary judgement upon request; making basic commitments on the executives behalf when interfacing with internal and external contacts; and independently resolving simple conflicts with the executives best interests in mind.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

  
  

  
* Pursues effective relationships with others by proactively providing resources, information, advice, and expertise with coworkers and members. Listens to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides mentoring to team members. Pursues self-development; creates plans and takes action to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; influences others through technical explanations and examples. Adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in approaches to work; helps others adapt to new tasks and processes. Supports and responds to the needs of others to support a business outcome.
  
* Completes work assignments autonomously by applying up-to-date expertise in subject area to generate creative solutions; ensures all procedures and policies are followed; leverages an understanding of data and resources to support projects or initiatives. Collaborates cross-functionally to solve business problems; escalates issues or risks as appropriate; communicates progress and information. Supports, identifies, and monitors priorities, deadlines, and expectations. Identifies, speaks up, and implements ways to address improvement opportunities for team.
  
* Independently plans and executes information dissemination by: drafting standard and nonstandard presentations, handouts, reports/spreadsheets, graphics, status reports, resource management reports, and other deliverables with regular review from senior colleagues; riting detailed correspondence (e.g., letters, reports, confidential documents) to staff, managers, and external members/providers, with review from team or manager; ing, sorting, and maintaining the integrity of department files, independently; ng a variety of software and databases to retrieve required information to write detailed reports.

The Rare Disease Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for unlocking operational and access challenges related to appropriate therapies across assigned health systems, specialty clinics, infusion centers, and sites of care to grow the overall rare disease business in the assigned accounts and market. * Translate account data and insights into clear opportunity hypotheses, action plans, and performance reviews of sites.

* Serve as the commercial lead for assigned account contracting opportunities, coordinating internal approvals and supporting compliant negotiation and execution.
* Identify and address barriers related to contracting, customer membership, ordering, distribution channel, formulary or pathway decisions, and product availability.

* Engage sites of care through education, workflow support, and coordinated resources that strengthen readiness to initiate and maintain therapy.
* Help customers diagnose and identify operational gaps that can delay treatment, including referral handoffs, scheduling, infusion capacity, care coordination, and post-initiation follow-up.

* Provide timely, actionable field insights into customer needs, competitive dynamics, reimbursement trends, and operational barriers with matrix colleagues.
* Monitor account performance and adapt priorities to deliver against agreed objectives in a compliant manner.
* Maintain accurate account plans, account affiliations, activity records, and opportunity documentation in required systems.
* Lead matrix planning and follow-through for priority account initiatives, clarifying partner roles, decision points, owners, and timelines.
